grid_truncation_disclosure.rationale: Pre-registered grid stopped at T_award=84; extended diagnostic recalculation over 85..92 shows true GO range 81..86 with max Youden J=0.825 at 85..86 (outside pre-registered grid). Because 83 lies near the center of the true GO range 81..86, T_award=83 is strictly retained per pre-registration without post-hoc shifting to 85-86.

holdout_protocol.no_go_action: Do NOT re-tune thresholds/prompts or re-run on Holdout v1. Any re-tuning requires building a brand-new unseen Holdout v2.

mandatory_supplementary_reports.description: P-1 to P-3 metrics after excluding videos where knows_work === true OR knows_award_history === true.
P-2 sensitivity on the 15 low-exposure / recent Tier 2 works only (award/release year 2022-2026 and view_count < 500k YouTube / < 100k Vimeo).
Per-genre false positive list (R-PRO >= T_award and R-LOW >= T_award), explicitly flagging anime-style TV CMs.
